correctedCritiques.pro-rational-acceptance-distinction: Strongest feature: The clarification distinguishes epistemic self-defeat from falsity or antecedent improbability, preventing a misreading and locating the conclusion in rational acceptability rather than metaphysical truth. Principal limitation: As a scope clarification, it independently establishes neither the reliability premise nor the transmission from reliability doubt to defeat, so its constructive force remains dependent upon those argumentative bridges. Live burden: Plantinga must preserve this conclusion while demonstrating that accepting naturalism and evolution gives the believer the relevant defeater, rather than merely introducing a skeptical possibility compatible with continued rational confidence. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional precision, calibration, relevance, and explanatory usefulness, while appropriately recognizing limited constructive independence as a feature of this clarificatory function.
correctedCritiques.con-content-conceptual-constraints: Strongest feature: Law identifies weakness in unrestricted content reassignment by arguing that a neural state’s behavioral role conceptually constrains which belief can intelligibly be attributed to the organism. Principal limitation: The response leaves its theory of content and the reach of constraints implicit, while excluding arbitrary attribution does not establish that admissible content accurately represents the external world. Live burden: Law must connect behavioral-role constraints not merely to action but to environmental truth conditions, while accommodating Plantinga’s concession that determinate content may supervene without corresponding to adaptive behavior. Locked score: The very strong band reflects diagnostic precision, exceptional responsiveness, stable presentation, and tentative force, moderated by the missing external-world accuracy bridge and underdeveloped account of semantic determination.
